text:
Predicates:
Mammal(x) ::: x is a mammal.
HaveTeeth(x) ::: x has teeth.
Platypus(x) ::: x is a platypus.
Humans(x) ::: x is a human.
NoTeeth(x) ::: x has no teeth.
Premises:
Some mammals have teeth ::: ∃x (Mammal(x) ∧ HaveTeeth(x))
Platypuses have no teeth ::: NoTeeth(platypus)
Platypuses are mammals ::: Mammal(platypus)
Humans have teeth ::: HaveTeeth(human)
Conclusion:
Platypuses are mammals with no teeth ::: Mammal(platypus) ∧ NoTeeth(platypus)
